title: Live Duel Concede and Focus Effect Choices
summary: Includes Alfredo’s button-corner review correction across shared lacquer and Practice UI, plus the approved live-duel confirmation and Focus Effect choices. Please review before merging.
review_steps: This revision replaces revision 3 and removes the opaque black corners around shared buttons. Inspect Menu and Concede controls, hovered/keyboard-focused buttons, and Practice Setup through Open Full Game. The button face and gold frame should remain intact, with the scene visible outside its silhouette.
Open Start Review.cmd. The game prepares a real Disreputable Deal decision; no match or deck setup is needed. Allow the duel entrance to finish.
Inspect the source, select a candidate, then Return to hand. Selection alone should not submit. Try Take no card on a fresh launch.
Open Other previews/Concede Match.cmd. Choose Menu > Concede match. Escape or Keep playing must preserve the duel; confirmation must end the whole match.

Try required straightening, attaching, destroying an attachment, Honor or Draw, two consecutive choices, and the crowded tray. After resolving, use Duel details to review the source-linked outcome, then Continue back to the same match.
Use Other Seat to inspect the waiting view. Menu > Switch seat must hide private cards until Reveal this seat. Reduced Motion opens the same decision without cinematic movement.
Record UI, QoL or rules feedback on PR #466. Alfredo approved the concepts; implementation acceptance and merge remain pending your review.
known_limitations: Review candidate only; nothing is merged automatically. Mendon’s rules-sensitive review and native Windows graphical play remain open.
Built from main de672f58 plus #448. Other unmerged UI and interaction preview PRs remain separate.
Prepared positions use real engine choices with manual seats. Close and reopen a launcher to reset. These fixtures do not modify the pinned Lion/Crane decks.
Windows package/runtime and launcher CI are separate from human graphical playtesting.
An auxiliary legacy static-art check reports a 0.50006104-pixel projection mismatch on both this branch and unchanged main. Live match, sandbox and transition checks pass; details are in the PR.
